user.title: Alibaba Cloud Bailian
user.description: Sign in with a [Bailian API key]({docs_url}). Region is required (Beijing is pre-selected). A workspace ID is required for Tokyo and Frankfurt, and optional elsewhere.

data_description.region: Bailian API keys and endpoints are not interchangeable across regions.
data_description.api_key: Create an API key in the same region you select here.
data_description.workspace_id: Optional for Beijing, Singapore, Virginia and Hong Kong. Required for Tokyo and Frankfurt dedicated endpoints. Filling it also lets the integration list models authorized for that workspace.

engines.title: Speech engines
engines.description: Conversation is always enabled. Turn off speech-to-text or text-to-speech if you only need text chat. You can change this later in the integration options.

data_description.enable_stt: Used by Assist satellites and voice pipelines. Leave off if you only type.
data_description.enable_tts: Used to speak replies. Leave off if you already have another TTS engine.

models.title: Models
models.description: The dropdown lists models this API key is authorized to call. Check refresh and submit to reload the list without saving other changes. You can still type a model ID.

data_description.chat_model: Only models authorized for this API key. Use a Flash/Turbo model for voice commands.
data_description.enable_thinking: Keep this off for home control. Thinking mode increases latency.
data_description.tts_voice: System voice such as Cherry, or a custom cloned/designed voice from your Bailian account.
data_description.refresh_models: Reload the authorized model list from Bailian. Other fields on this page are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Bailian. Check your network and region.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key, or the key does not match the selected region.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.workspace_required: This region requires a workspace ID.

abort.already_configured: This Bailian account is already configured.

data_description.enable_stt: Disable this if you do not need Bailian to transcribe voice. Assist can keep using another STT engine.
data_description.enable_tts: Disable this if you already use another TTS engine, or do not need spoken replies.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Allow the model to call Assist tools for exposed entities.
data_description.prompt: System instructions for the conversation agent. Templates are supported.
data_description.chat_model: Only models this API key is authorized to call. Check refresh and submit to reload the list.
data_description.enable_thinking: Keep this off for voice control. Thinking mode increases latency.
data_description.stt_prompt: Optional context that improves recognition of device names and scenes.
data_description.tts_voice: Includes cloned and designed voices from your Bailian account, listed before system voices.
data_description.refresh_models: Reload authorized models from Bailian. Other fields on this page are kept.
